title: Jerome and Clarkdale with option for Verde Canyon Scenic Railroad
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the rich history of Old Town Jerome, starting at the Douglas Mansion Museum, where stories of the mining days come alive. After delving into the past, enjoy free time to browse the unique shops and galleries and savor lunch from local eateries. Next, there is option for the scenic rail ride through the stunning Verde Canyon, lasting nearly 4 hours round trip, before concluding your adventure with a visit to Old Town Cottonwood for antique shopping or a refreshing drink. 
- Visit the historic Douglas Mansion Museum and learn about Jerome's mining history
- Enjoy free time to explore shops, galleries, and lunch options
- OPTIONAL Scenic rail ride into Verde Canyon lasting nearly 4 hours
- Conclude with a stop in Old Town Cottonwood for antiques or drinks
